Rules.InvariantScript:
//Checks if there are anyback cameras, if there are none then default the camera to the first one otherwise use the first back camera
If(IsBlank(LookUp(Camera_44.AvailableDevices, "back" in Name|| "Back" in Name).Id),0,LookUp(Camera_44.AvailableDevices, "back" in Name || "Back" in Name).Id)

//"Tap or Click the camera to take a picture"
Concat(Camera_44.AvailableDevices, Name&" "&Id)

If( "<img" in CopyPasteRTE_45.HtmlText, Collect(FeedbackImages,{copyName:App.ActiveScreen.Name&"ScreenShot "&Text( Now(), "mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss" ), base64Image:CopyPasteRTE_45.HtmlText});Collect(JointAttachments,{Name:App.ActiveScreen.Name&" ScreenShot "&Text(Now(),DateTimeFormat.UTC), Value:CopyPasteRTE_45.HtmlText});
Reset(CopyPasteRTE_45);, Notify("No Valid Image"));
If(CountRows(FeedbackImages)>0,CountRows(FeedbackImages)&" Screenshot(s) or Photos Added","No Media Attached")
